main_text.l: fi tempore:Herodotus. De Laconica lingua leges inferius elemento L.Dores praecipuè, ut platystomi,incessantur à Græcis, quòd ju sto frequentius in dictionibus a literam inge rant, unde apud Theocritum garrulæ mu lierculæ coarguuntur πλαˈτεαἰ᾽οιʃαυ ἀπαν τα, ut quæ Syracusiæ forent: Cælius Rho diginus.
ꝗElamitae, Arabiç gens Apostolos Do mini Hierosolymis in Pentecoste suâ linguâ loquentes admirabunda audivit.

ꝗGalatae, qui super Phrygiam incolunt,coccum fruticem linguâ vernaculâ hys nominant,Paufanias in Phocicis. Est autem is frutex ejusdem generis cum ilice aquifo lia,quàm Galli Europæi hodieq; bous vel bus appellant.Quare hoc etiam argumento,Ga latarum in Asia eandem esse aut fuisse lin guam,quæ in Europa Gallorum est aut fuit, evincetur.Vide plura mox in Gallica lingua vetere. Trocini(Germaniæ populi) à lacessen do dicti: tolissogobi à ferendis arcubus co gnominati: socii Brenni & Thessaloni, in Asia sedes posuerunt: dicti Galatæ, ad quos sanctus Paulus scripsit, Iohan. Auen tinus.

marginalia.note: Galatarū in Asia ea dem lingua quæ in Eu ropa Gallo rum.

page.notes: Marginal notes (right margin, beside the Galatae paragraph): "Galatarū in Asia eadem lingua quæ in Europa Gallorum." Printed in three short lines: "Galatarū / in Asia ea- / dem lingua / quæ in Eu- / ropa Gallo- / rum." Doubtful readings: the Greek in "Theocritum" (πλαˈτεαἰ᾽οιʃαυ ἀπαν τα) is a rough reading of the printed Greek and may be inexact. "bous vel bus" (printed "hows vel hus") and "hys" (printed "hys") are uncertain. "tolissogobi" is copied as read. The head word "Galatae" is set with an initial-capital Q-style sign (ꝗ) that is likely a paragraph mark. The line "ꝗElamitae" and "ꝗEpirotarvm" have the same mark. Ink show-through and stains are present but not transcribed.
